package grammar

type Event enum {
	Ready struct{}
}

type MultilineEvent enum
{
	Waiting struct{}
}

type Port struct { number int } checked
type CheckedRecord struct {
	value int
	owner %User
	history []%User
	lookup map[string]%User
	updates chan %User
	callback func(%User) %User
} checked

type UserPointer = %User
type UserPointerMap = map[string][]%*User
type DirectUserPointerMap = map[string]%User
var currentUser %User
type WhereAlias where

func read(ok bool, owner %User) error {
	_ = Request{..default}
	value := load() /* keep */ !
	value = load()!!
	value = CheckedRecord{value: 1}!
	_ = !ok
	_ = left%right
	_ = left % Thing
	_ = []int{for _, item := range values { if item > 0 { item } }}
	switch event.Tag() {
	exhaustive:
	}
	where := 1
	checked := true
	enum := 2
	_ = enum{}
	_ = append(values, defaults...)
	return nil
}

func pointerParameter(value *Record) {}
func nonNilParameter(value %Record) {}
func nonNilResult() %Record { return currentUser }
func nonNilResults() (%Record, error) { return currentUser, nil }

func (value *Record) pointerReceiver() {}
func (value %Record) nonNilReceiver() {}
func inlineModulo() { _ = left % Thing }

func multilineParameter(
	parameter %ParameterRecord,
) {}

func (
	receiver %ReceiverRecord,
) multilineReceiver() {}

func unnamedParameter(%UnnamedRecord) {}
func (%UnnamedReceiver) unnamedReceiver() {}

func composedParameter(first %*OuterRecord, second %%NestedRecord) {}
func (receiver %*ReceiverRecord) composedReceiver() {}
func (receiver %%DeepRecord) doubleReceiver() {}

func signatureModulo(value [(Left %Right)]Record) {}
func bodyModulo() { _ = left %Thing }
func multilineBodyModulo() {
	_ = bodyLeft %BodyThing
}
